title: What each strategy splits
summary: Match each parallelism strategy to what it splits across GPUs.

options.text: The experts of a mixture-of-experts layer, with tokens sent to the GPU of their expert
The vocabulary of the tokenizer, so each GPU sees a different set of words
The weight matrices inside each layer, so one matmul runs across several GPUs
The layers: each GPU runs a contiguous group of layers
The batch: each GPU runs the whole model on different examples
Weights, gradients and optimizer state across data-parallel ranks, gathered layer by layer
